name: Vacuum extension 68 mm
description: Short adapter that lets the old brush extension fit the vacuum's nozzle. Front end: a 25 mm push-in plug matching the nozzle opening (41.8 mm wide, one long side flat, the other curved out, 18 mm high at the ends and 20 mm in the middle; 0.2 mm clearance plus two small crush ribs per long side, small lead-in). Back end: a 23 mm long socket for the thin tongue of the old extension, same width and curve but 3 mm thinner than the opening (15.2 / 17.2 mm high), 0.1 mm clearance per side and small crush ribs inside. The old tongue ends in a wider collar that stays outside and is slanted about 50 degrees to the axis, so the socket's rim AND its floor are cut at that angle (the wall on the rounded side is about 13 mm shorter). Walls are 1.5 mm. Only as long as needed: 68 mm in total (43 mm tube + 25 mm plug), straight air channel through. Prints standing on the plug end with the socket opening up, no supports. PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters. The old part's holes/latches are not copied: it holds by friction. Print the two short test pieces first. Not printed or fitted.
